ai_summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited's Board approved strategic operational shifts, including the termination of an unprofitable hospital agreement that contributed negligibly (0.15%) to revenue, aiming to cease sustained operating losses. Concurrently, the company will acquire an additional 12% equity stake in its existing subsidiary, United CIIGMA Institute of Medical Sciences, for up to Rs. 40.93 crores, fulfilling a pre-existing put option by minority shareholders and consolidating its position in a larger healthcare asset. These actions indicate a strategic focus on divesting underperforming assets while increasing ownership in significant existing operations, with no apparent red flags.
